Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning legal notices for constitutional amendments and state measures.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to legal notices for constitutional amendments andstate measures; repealing RCW 29A.52.330 and 29A.52.340; and providinga contingent effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 29A.52.330 (Constitutional amendments and state measuresNotice method) and 2003 c 111 s 1311; and RCW 29A.52.340 (Constitutional amendments and state measuresNotice contents) and 2003 c 111 s 1312.

This act takes effect if the proposedamendment to Article XXIII, section 1 of the state Constitutionrepealing legal notices for proposed constitutional amendments (Z0729/09) is validly submitted to and is approved and ratified by thevoters at the next general election. If the proposed amendment is notapproved and ratified, this act is void in its entirety.
